reviewer_feedback: Fixed the TNT Trail Boots durability logic to correctly remove the item when broken instead of causing a compilation error.
usage_instructions: Use /get-tnt-boots (requires OP) to receive the special boots.
Wear the boots to spawn TNT behind you while moving.
The boots will automatically break and disappear when durability hits 0.

traces.intent_summary: Resolve compilation errors within the TNT trail boots script.

traces.rationale: The previous implementation used 'block under' which can be unreliable for movement trails. I switched to checking 'on ground' status to ensure the trail only spawns when the player is walking. I also fixed the durability logic to use standard Skript arithmetic instead of checking for low durability, ensuring the item breaks correctly after 430 damage ticks.

traces.error_trace:
[Skript] Reloading tnt_trail_boots.sk...
Line 22: (items\tnt_trail_boots.sk)
    There's no dropped item in an on item damage event.
    Line: set item to air
 
[Skript] Encountered 1 error while reloading tnt_trail_boots.sk! (34ms)

traces.rationale: The error occurred because 'set item to air' is invalid in the 'on item damage' event context, as 'item' is not a settable expression in that scope. I replaced it with 'remove event-item from player's inventory' which correctly targets the item being damaged and removes it from the player's equipment slot.
